title: Unread hub notices step from push to one email per thread to a daily digest, and stop once read

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: each notice goes out on its own channels at once, so a busy Plan thread sends one email per comment and nothing respects quiet hours. Fix: a ladder (in-app at once, web push after 1 to 2 minutes if unseen, one email per thread after 15 to 30 minutes if unread, daily digest for the rest), cancelled on read; quiet hours in the person's time zone on notification preferences.

Tags and team-thread words ring the bell at once; lib/notifications/ladder-route.ts schedules a push after 2 minutes and, for a tag, one email per thread per half hour after 20, each a hub-ladder job that stops once the thread's bell rows are read or cleared and waits out quiet hours (notification_preferences.quiet_hours_start/end, set in Settings). Migration 20270346330000.
